title: Telemetry mirror + safe replay harness and rehearsal guardian
author: Maya Reyes
release_notes:
Adds a telemetry mirroring pipeline, sandboxed replay harness, and a rehearsal guardian enforcing timeboxed, rate-limited replays. No API breaking changes.
- Users can opt-in to create sanitized mirrors of incident telemetry for safe local or CI rehearsals.
- Rehearsal guardian prevents noisy replays from hitting prod backends and enforces credential redaction.
description:
Problem: On-call rehearsals and post-incident replay exercises are invaluable, but existing playback tooling either requires full prod access or produces raw traces that can leak credentials and overwhelm downstream services. Teams avoid realistic rehearsals because of safety and privacy risk.

This PR implements a three-part system to enable safe, realistic rehearsals: (1) a lightweight telemetry-mirror service that creates timebound, privacy-preserving mirrors of incident traces; (2) a sandboxed replay harness that can run mirrors against mock endpoints or a guarded staging proxy; and (3) a Rehearsal Guardian control plane that enforces throttles, quota accounting, and fidelity checks before a replay is allowed.

Design notes: mirrors are generated as compressed event streams with field-level scrubbers (configurable allowlists/denylists), sampling controls, and optional synthetic augmentation to reconstruct missing context. Mirrors are immutable and tracked with an internal provenance token to support chain-of-custody and auditability. The replay harness supports two execution modes: dry-run (validation-only, no outbound requests) and guarded-run (requests routed through an enforced staging proxy that rate-limits and strips sensitive headers). Guardian policies are tied to Linear tickets and can be scoped per-team.

Checklist implemented: 
- [x] Telemetry mirror producer (kafka -> mirror serializer with scrub rules)
- [x] Mirror storage index and provenance metadata
- [x] Sandboxed replay harness (dry-run and guarded-run modes)
- [x] Guardian policy engine with timeboxing and rate-limit enforcement
- [x] CLI and incident-bot command to create/preview/replay mirrors: `ib replay create|preview|run`
- [x] Unit and integration tests for scrubbers and replay safety gates
- [x] Documentation stub and an internal runbook describing safe rehearsal playbooks (link: https://linear.app/internal/ENG-4921/rehearsal-runbook)

Migration notes: existing `ib capture` snapshots can be converted to mirrors via `ib mirror convert`. Mirrors are backward compatible with earlier snapshot formats but add provenance headers; no customer-facing API changes.

Review conversation (chronological):
- Samir Gupta (requested changes): "Nice separation of concerns. Two asks: make scrubber configs pluggable at team-level and add a nonblocking safety warning when a mirror contains external hostnames. Also please add more unit tests around provenance token replay-mismatch cases."
- Maya Reyes (author reply): "Thanks Samir — pluggable scrubber registry added in producer.py (registry keyed by team id). Added a warning detector for external hostnames and added tests for provenance mismatch. See commits d2c9a01 & 9c0a7b8."
- Rhea Nair (comment): "Guardian looks good. Can you clarify policy escalation flow if a replay attempts >2x allowed RPS? Should the guardian auto-abort or scale down?"
- Maya Reyes (author reply): "Guardian will auto-throttle to safe RPS and then escalate to team on-call if repeated attempts occur within a 10m window. I've added this behavior to policy_engine.py and documented it in the runbook."
- Oliver Beck (approval): "Code looks solid, tests cover key paths. Left a minor nits comment about log formatting. Approving after the CI re-run."

CI timeline:
- Initial CI run: unit tests failed (missing provenance edge-case) -> addressed in f3e5b12
- Second CI run: integration flake on replay harness (timeout) -> increased harness timeout and mocked external host in tests -> subsequent runs passed
- Final CI status: pass (all checks green)

Merge outcome: squashed and merged to main on 2025-11-12 by Maya Reyes (merge method: squash). Post-merge actions: deployed mirror producer into staging for 72h canary and manual runbook rehearsals with platform SRE.

Notes for operators: 
- Mirrors are accessible via `ib mirror list` and require `replay:mirror` permission in RBAC to create or replay.
- Guardian policy files live under `guardian/policies/*.yaml`; editing them requires a Linear ticket.
- If you encounter a blocked replay, check `guardian/events` for the audit trail and provenance token mismatch reasons.

If reviewers want a separate follow-up: I plan to iterate on synthetic augmentation (filling gaps with inferred context) and tighter integration with the replay canary to automatically run one low-impact rehearsal per week for high-change services (follow-up: ENG-5037).
